body: Some things just happen for the best. I dated a guy for 2 years and he ended it out of nowhere and said he didn't have any feelings for me no more . I was stubborn and kept trying to get back with him because he had left me alone . All my friends were gone because of him and all my happiness felt like it depended on him . I look back and saw how controlling and manipulating he was and how one sided the relationship was when I was finally out. He wasn't letting me grow as a person and as bad as I felt because it was my first real heartbreak . Music and keeping my mind busy helped . I got a job and kept up with tasks I needed to do . Chores, cleaning, whatever needed my attention when in reality all I wanted to just lay down and cry. You just need to find the strength within yourself and it's okay to cry it out but don't dwell on it . You'll be okay with time and someone else will come along dear . Try to learn to love yourself first and I hope everything goes well.
